## `runtime/proto/token.proto`

Source: [`runtime/proto/token.proto`](https://github.com/google-ai-edge/LiteRT-LM/blob/df6df5b84d5845b49889f631ed4cac80b4325dd3/runtime/proto/token.proto)

| Scope | Kind | Name | Type | # | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
|  | message | [`TokenUnion`](https://github.com/google-ai-edge/LiteRT-LM/blob/df6df5b84d5845b49889f631ed4cac80b4325dd3/runtime/proto/token.proto#L31) |  |  | A union of token ids and token strings, representing single semantic meaning.  Single semantic meaning might be represented by single token id or multiple token ids, depending on the tokenizer. For example, in Gemma3N <start_of_turn> represent the start of turn, and can be represented by a single token id 105. And some models use multiple token ids to represent the end of sentence, signaling to terminate the model decoding.  Note some models do not have valid string representation for all tokens, e.g. Gemma3, Gemma3N. Where the <bos> token id is 2, but the "<bos>" string would not map to the same token id. In such case, we use token_ids to represent the token instead of token_str. |
| TokenUnion | oneof | [`token_union`](https://github.com/google-ai-edge/LiteRT-LM/blob/df6df5b84d5845b49889f631ed4cac80b4325dd3/runtime/proto/token.proto#L32) |  |  |  |

| TokenUnion | field | [`token_str`](https://github.com/google-ai-edge/LiteRT-LM/blob/df6df5b84d5845b49889f631ed4cac80b4325dd3/runtime/proto/token.proto#L34) | string (oneof token_union) | 2 |  |
